heroEyebrow: A gentle path inward, walked with Becky
heroHeading: Healing is not linear. You don't have to walk it alone.
heroIntro: There is a world within you — quieter and more resilient than the pain you have been carrying. This is a warm, unhurried place to go looking for it, with someone beside you the whole way.
quote: Healing is not linear — it's an unfolding journey that requires safety, curiosity, and courage.
conditionsHeading: Support for the weight you've been carrying

conditions.title: Heaviness that won't lift
conditions.body: When sadness has settled in and stayed — even after you've tried the things that were supposed to help.

conditions.title: A mind that won't rest
conditions.body: Worry running quietly behind everything, and the tiredness that comes from always bracing for what's next.

conditions.title: What the past still holds
conditions.body: Old hurt that lives in the body and shapes today, long after you thought you had moved on.

conditions.title: A longing for something more
conditions.body: For those who aren't in crisis, but sense there is more depth and aliveness available to them.

conditionsLink: See what this can help with, honestly →
journeyHeading: You'll know every step before you take it

steps.title: Finding your footing
steps.body: We meet, take our time, and get to know one another. You'll learn what to expect and ask anything you like. Nothing moves forward until you feel genuinely ready.

steps.title: The journey inward
steps.body: You settle somewhere soft and quiet, with music and a blanket if you'd like. The medicine opens a door, and Becky stays with you the whole way through.

steps.title: Finding your way back
steps.body: Afterward we sit together and make sense of what surfaced — gently turning what you glimpsed into something that lasts in everyday life.
